products.title: Newton Running Distance S 9
products.description: Newton Distance S 9 Running Shoes A staple racer to many, including 3X Ironman World Champion Craig Alexander. This stability model of the award-winning Distance features light minimalistic overlays and dual-density foam for a high-performance feel. Ultra Breathable Mesh Upper The Newton Distance 9 running shoe is built for speed. Engineered with an ultra lightweight, ultra-breathable mesh upper the Distance 9 will have you clocking up the miles and hitting new records without feeling the heat. As cool air permeates the mesh, any uncomfortable heat build-up is removed creating a regulated temperature and a healthy environment that feet can thrive in. The new minimalistic overlays offer support without adding unnecessary bulk or weight and work in tandem with a traditional lace closure for a secure, locked down fit. The no-sew toe cap eliminates discomfort from chaffing and rubbing for a distraction-free ride. Newtonium Cushioned Midsole Featuring a full foot Newtonium cushioned midsole, cushioned lugs in the forefoot and heel provide full-foot cushioned protection, attenuating shock impact where you strike down the most alleviating stress on the joints and reducing fatigue. Working in tandem with the Newtonium cushioned midsole is the action/reaction technology providing exceptional energy return. Generated by the active movement of the cushioned lugs, the active/reactive technology creates a trampoline-like effect responding to your every step with quicker bounce-back for effective and highly responsive energy return. Constructed with a second density medial support the Distance S 9 provides a firmer medial side post to prevent overpronation during running. SHARC Outsole The Distance 9 shoes SHARC Outsole consists of a high abrasion and high-density rubber providing increased and enhanced floor fighting traction in both dry and wet conditions.

dialogue.user: The ASICS Men's GT-2000 7 Running Shoes sound interesting. What are its main features regarding comfort and athletic performance?
dialogue.agent:
The ASICS Men's GT-2000 7 Running Shoes offer a good balance of comfort and performance features:

**Comfort:**
*   **SpevaFoam 45 Lasting:** Provides a soft platform feel for enhanced comfort.
*   **Ortholite Sockliner:** Helps with moisture management to keep your feet dry.
*   **SpevaFoam Midsole Material:** Contributes to a comfortable ride by improving bounce-back.

**Performance:**
*   **FlyteFoam Lyte Technology:** This is ASICS' lightest midsole formulation, offering continuous cushioning.
*   **GEL Technology Cushioning System (Rearfoot and Forefoot):** This system is designed to absorb shock during impact and toe-off phases, allowing for smoother transitions.

The shoe has an average rating of 4.7 stars from 499 reviews and costs $120. Some customers praise its support and cushioning, while others have noted a decline in quality compared to older versions.

top_reviews.title: Not The Same GT-2000 Series Quality
top_reviews.text: I have owned several pairs of Asics GT-2000 running shoes. Love them as they fit, are sturdy and well made. I wanted to buy another Series (4) shoe but no more to be found. The reviews for the Series (5) and (6) were not that great. So I went ahead and purchased the new Series (7). Not the same shoe anymore. See photo. Shoe on left is my old (4) and right (7). Notice the toe: old shoe vinyl is stitched; new shoe seamless fabric. Notice the laces: old shoe sturdy vinyl stitched; new shoe seamless fabric. Not sure what this 'new age' fabric is but I don't like it. It seems the old shoe was made of several parts designed and put together. The new shoe seems like one big piece of fabric that has been molded and shaped to fit. No stitches, only glue and seamless fabric. I'll keep the GT-2000 (7) they feel okay and I ran with them today. But they are not the classic GT-2000 series shoe anymore. Get used to it, Asics has reduced their material and manufacturing costs with this fabric material and they now seem like any plain old running shoe. For the price, I expected more. My last GT-2000 shoe.

top_reviews.title: Terrific Addition to the Asics GT 2000 Series
top_reviews.text: I've been wearing Asics GT 2000 running shoes for years and have always found they suited my running style and mileage very well. But after the middling-to-poor reviews that the GT 2000 6 series garnered, I was concerned: had the GT 2000 series run its course? I'm happy to report it hasn't, not at least by the evidence of the GT 2000 7. The shoes feels lighter than the previous entries in the series, but its support, especially in the heel box, is superb. The front of the shoe also does a very good and very noticeable job of distributing the force of my foot hitting the running surface. The shoe is also stylish--I bought mine in black/white--with flexible meshing around the front. I was nervous about the purchase--but I shouldn't have been. Terrific shoe.

top_reviews.title: Asics quality ended with the GT 2000-5
top_reviews.text: I have worn Asics GT-2000 brand for over a decade now. Versions 2, 3, 4 and 5 were absolutely spectacular shoes. I generally would buy the version from the previous year to save some money since there are few differences between the shoes. Until version 6 which is what I would have purchased this year. The reviews stated that the quality of version 6 was far far worse than any previous generation. So I went ahead and shelled out the $120 for the version 7 back in January. It is now just 8 months into wearing the version 7 and these are toast. All of the tread is gone and there are large flat spots all on the bottom of the shoe. These after 8 months of standard walking and jogging use look like my old version 5 pair after 18 months of the same beating. The old versions I would wear would regularly go 1.5 years before wearing out all of the tread. If these shoes only last less than half of the time the old ones did, then these shoes don't deserve to be more than $50-60. Asics, you have lost my trust and confidence. I am afraid after a decade of loyalty, your decision to get rich quick has cost you many customers, including myself. I will have to look for quality elsewhere. Shame on you.

dialogue.user: The ASICS Men's GT-2000 7 Running Shoes have a good rating and fall within my budget, and the cushioning features sound promising. However, the mention of "a decline in quality compared to older versions" makes me a bit hesitant. Can you tell me if the Brooks Women’s Hyperion Max Neutral Running Shoe also emphasizes comfort and athletic performance?
dialogue.agent:
Yes, the **Brooks Women’s Hyperion Max Neutral Running Shoe** also emphasizes comfort and athletic performance. It has a 4.8 average rating from 5 reviews and costs $169.95.

Here are its key features:

**Comfort:**
*   **Nitrogen-infused DNA FLASH cushioning:** This lightweight cushioning is highly responsive and adapts to your stride, offering a comfortable feel.
*   **Stretch woven upper:** Provides a comfortable and breathable fit.
*   **Substantial midsole foam:** Helps absorb impact, contributing to comfort during runs.

**Athletic Performance:**
*   **Neutral support:** Suitable for runners who don't need stability features.
*   **Propulsive design:** The midsole is curved at the heel and toe to help propel you forward.
*   **Green Rubber outsole:** Designed for fast and effortless transitions, aiding in quick-paced runs.
*   **3D Fit Print:** Offers extra structure for a secure fit and support.

This shoe is designed for runners looking to achieve their fastest times, with features focused on responsiveness, energy return, and quick transitions.
